methodology: Offline built HTML; native buttons, keyboard, touch and reload. Explicit fixtures fund ordinary materials, restore damaged body, position at registered mall anchors, extend enemy attack cooldowns for transaction/connector checks, trigger terminal conditions and rewind the saved base cursor to verify offline recovery. Scoped write failures target the intended bag, floor or terminal transaction while allowing unrelated periodic checkpoints. These fixtures do not prove natural balance or reference-image fidelity. Ordinary entry has a separate context without test hooks.
